svg.title: Active Learning · gaze tracking (2026)
svg.desc: Active Learning: webcam gaze tracking with ResNet-18 and active learning.
svg.text: deep learning · course project · ENSIM / Le Mans Université
Predicts where a person looks on screen from a webcam image (ResNet-18), and uses
active learning to choose which new images are worth labelling.
With half of the new domain labelled, the mixed strategy reaches 67 px mean error,
